name: Current Licensed and Funded Early Education and Care Programs
attribution: MA Department of Early Education and Care
description:
This dataset includes a snapshot of programs currently licensed or funded by the Department of Early Education and Care (EEC). The data is pulled from EEC's Licensing Education Analytic Database (LEAD). For a list of all current and historical early education and care programs please visit the Licensed and Funded Early Education and Care Programs dataset. Data are updated monthly at the beginning of each month.

Licensed programs are programs that are subject to licensing regulations by EEC, which include meeting health and safety standards, training and professional development requirements, criminal and background checks, and maintaining appropriate ratios of educators to children. Licensed programs can include any of the following: family child care and group and school age programs. For more information on licensed programs click here.

Funded programs are programs that are not subject to licensure by EEC but have the approval from EEC to provide subsidized child care for low-income or at-risk families. Funded programs can include any of the following: public schools; private schools; religious schools; and government, tribal, and military child care programs. For more information on funded providers click here.

The types of programs in this dataset include:

  • Licensed Family Child Care is child care provided in someone's home where the caretaker is not related to the children.

  • Licensed Center-Based Care, sometimes called group and school age programs, provide early education and care for young children in a non-residential setting such as a school or community center. These programs include several types of early education and care such as: Center-based care for infants, toddlers, preschool, or kindergarten age children; Early Head Start and Head Start programs; and Out-of- school time programs that operate before/after school or during the summer.

  • Funded Public Schools that participate in CCFA are included here and public schools that do not participate in CCFA are not included here. For data on all public schools with pre-K enrollment, please see the Pre-Kindergarten and Kindergarten Enrollment dataset.

  • Funded Private Schools that participate in CCFA are included here and private schools that do not participate in CCFA are not included here. For data on all private schools with pre-K enrollment, please see the Non-Public School Enrollment dataset.

columns.name: LICENSED_PROVIDER_STATUS
columns.description: Applies only to licensed programs. Contains the values: current, expired, or renewal in progress. Will be null for funded programs.

columns.name: FUNDED_PROVIDER_STATUS
columns.description: Applies only to funded programs. Contains the values: current, expired, or funding renewal in progress. Will be null for licensed programs.

columns.name: REGULATORY_STATUS
columns.description: Applies only to FCCs. May have the values active or inactive. Value will be null for non-FCC programs. Fore more information about FCC inactive status, see https://www.mass.gov/doc/inactive-policy-for-family-child-care/download#:~:text=Inactive%20Status%20allows%20a%20Family,the%20outcome%20of%20an%20investigation.

columns.name: FIRST_ISSUED_DATE
columns.description: Date the program first received license from EEC or was approved to be funded by EEC

columns.name: LICENSED_CAPACITY
columns.description: The total number of children that a program can serve at a given time.  Note: 1) Licensed capacity by age is not available for Family Child Care programs or Group and School Age programs with a capacity of 10 or fewer children. 2) Family Child Care programs' license capacity usually start at 6 and vary between 6-10. In some cases, a program cannot be approved to care for 6 children due to factors such as lack of sufficient space. 3) Classrooms in Group and School Age programs often overlap age groups, so capacity by age will not equal licensed capacity. For instance, if a preschool program uses the same space as the after-school school-age program, both preschool and after school capacities would be listed, but both groups cannot be in attendance at the same time because they occupy the same space, so licensed capacity would be lower than the sum of capacity by age.

columns.name: VOUCHER_CONTRACT
columns.description: Value is true if a program has an EEC voucher agreement or contract to serve children with child care financial assistance (CCFA).

columns.name: C3_ATTESTATION
columns.description: Starting Nov 1, 2025, to receive C3 funding, providers must attest they are willing to accept children with vouchers (EEC's Child Care Financial Assistance). A value of "Yes" represents that a program has attested they are willing. A value of "Exempt" represents that a program has received an exemption. Null values represent that a program does not participate in C3.

columns.name: HEAD_START
columns.description: Indicates whether or not a program participates in Head Start, either as a program site or as a partner site. Measure available beginning 12/2/2025.

columns.name: EARLY_HEAD_START
columns.description: Indicates whether or not a program participates in Early Head Start either as a program site or as a partner site. Measure available beginning 12/2/2025.

columns.name: COI_CAT
columns.description: Child Opportunity Index Category. State-normed COI 3.0-2021. Contains the values: very low, low, moderate, high, very high.
